notes.title: We've smashed the bugs!
notes.content:
[b][color="#FFB43D"]Hello, Survivors![/color][/b] [strike][i]If you actually survived on our new Arena :|[/i][/strike]

There are just under two weeks left in the [b]Trouble Rumble[/b] event, and we hope everyone who wants to earn the awesome outfits still has time to do so! Also, don't forget that the top 10 players on the Arena will receive a [b]full copy of the game[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/6fd5858c409ab924f564354762ac4f6412341aee.png[/img]

In the meantime, we've released an update fixing the main bugs. Here's what's inside:

[list]
[*] Added tutorial.
[*] Fixed the issue with using medkits.
[*] Fixed acid damage, which will no longer deal constantly increasing amounts of damage.
[*] Adjusted the spawn location of spitters.
[*] Fixed animations and behavior of boomers.
[*] Players will no longer get stuck in the lobby after completing the event.
[*] Minor adjustments to weapon balance and zombie health.
[/list]
If you happen to spot a bug, please let us know on[b] [url="https://discord.com/invite/3GTzTj7bWp "]Discord[/url][/b] - we'll look into it :) And feel free to drop by just to chat too!

Also, we're participating in the [b]Isometric Sale festival[/b]. As always, we recommend checking out the cool games featured in the event. You might just find something you would love.

[b][color="#FFB43D"]So you survived?[/color][/b]
[list]
[*] [b][url="https://x.com/BroUSurvived "]X[/url]
[*] [url="https://discord.com/invite/3GTzTj7bWp "]Discord[/url]
[*] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/brousurvived.bsky.social "]BlueSky[/url]
[*] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@BUSBroUSurvived "]YouTube[/url][/b]
[/list]
[b]And don't forget to wishlist ⬇️[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852700/BUS_Bro_u_Survived/

notes.title: Trouble Rumble
notes.content:
[b][color="#FFB43D"]From August 1 to August 19 the battle for survival begins[/color][/b] - the arena is activated, zombies are already rushing into battle, and only you can stop their horde!

Fight through waves of enemies and earn exclusive outfits that will carry over to the full version of the game at launch. And yes - all of them were inspired by your ideas! If you want to contribute more, share your thoughts in our [b][url=https://discord.gg/wtJQWWCDyU ]Discord server[/url][/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/22ee38d771d778428ad2f6c62f92427bcd110997.png[/img]

[b]During the event, you can expect:[/b]
[list]
[*] Counterattacks, finishers, deadly traps, and total annihilation of every single zombie - all thanks to the new combat system! 💣
[*] Three unique outfits that you can unlock by surviving zombie waves. (Wear them proudly both during the event and after the game's release!)
[*] The Crown of the Great Victory - for those who survive a full 100 waves! 👑
[*] And the adventure doesn't end at wave 100: the top 10 players will receive a [b]Steam copy of the game[/b]! Keep an eye on the leaderboard!
[/list]

Share your screenshots, clips, and screams of horror (or triumph!) - we'll collect the most epic moments into a final video recap!

notes.title: 100 000 survivors!
notes.content:
[b][h1][color="#FFB43D"]Hello![/color][/h1][/b]

Our bus has arrived with some joyful news — [b] we’ve hit 100,000 wishlist additions![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/b4ea381b828773eb759383124cc5f584a3f73fb3.png[/img]

And here’s what we’ve learned:
[list]
[*] It’s impossible to implement everything you want in a game — but we aim for the impossible!
[*] There’s never enough coffee!
[*] Development takes a lot of time and effort, but the very idea of creating a co-op game with a deep story and tons of interesting mechanics keeps our team moving forward.
[/list]

Right now, the bus is picking up speed toward release, and ahead of us is a [b]massive playtest[/b]. We want you [i](our amazing players)[/i] to be the first to try out the [b]entirely new combat system[/b]. And we’ve also taken into account a huge number of complaints — so we’ve [u]completely rewritten the networking code[/u]: [b]no more errors and no more high ping![/b]

[b][color="#FFB43D"]Thank you once again - and see you at the next stop![/color][/b]

[h1]Our socials:[/h1]
[list]

[*] [url="https://www.youtube.com/ @BUSBroUSurvived"]YouTube[/url][/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our team worked quickly on a small update:

Limited FPS.

Fixed bugs with weapons: they now remain consistent when moving to another location and do not drop without reason.

Added a progress icon to the burner, making it easier to work with.

Corrected the text in the Bus Customizer.

Enlarged G! He's a big boy now

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/0ca05462da4a1ca43a550ffc0bf13826101fec02.gif[/img]

Thank you very much for your support and feedback :) Also, we have a small request for you - do not stop writing to us. If you have caught a bug or you have an idea, or maybe you have made a cool video about your adventure with friends - send everything! This helps us understand how to make the game even more interesting.

Don't forget to download the update!

notes.title: Festival "Zombies vs. Vampires"
notes.content:
We are taking part in the amazing festival "Zombies vs. Vampires" 🦇

But that's not all the good news... Together with the festival, we are releasing an updated demo! What awaits you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/ebc1157c1520c8553629e90284110fe48a5aacf4.gif[/img]

- We have reworked the locations of the first demo, based on your wishes. The player's route has become more intuitive, we have added hints and navigation, fixed bugs, and you can also find something interesting in the locations...

- By popular demand, we have added control settings

- We have added a physical model of bus behavior - knock down zombies with style, accelerate and drift

- And most importantly - Bus customization! At the moment, it is available in a separate menu. You can customize the appearance, add fun improvements and enjoy your creation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920467/79a5e9768db6dd5cf5bf4a71a29f3723e033cfee.gif[/img]

We listened to your feedback and put all our efforts into making the gameplay as comfortable as possible. If you encounter a bug, write to our bot in the #bug-report channel on Discord.

We hope for your support and will be waiting for screenshots with your cool buses 👽
